title: Views
description: Creating, managing, and querying views, including indexed views and system views.
longDescription: This module covers SQL Server views. You'll learn how to create, rename, list, and drop views, retrieve view information, and create indexed views for performance optimization.
whatYouLearn: Understand what views are and why they are useful
Create views using the CREATE VIEW statement
Drop views using the DROP VIEW statement
Retrieve view information using system catalog and stored procedures
Rename views using SSMS and Transact-SQL
List all views in a database
Create indexed views for performance optimization
